title: TipsInteractionModeratedPayload
description: tips.interaction.moderated v1 (OpenVibe.Tips server/domain/moderation.js record). A moderation outcome for a paid message (and the name that came with it): the creator's word filter starred words out at settlement (filtered) or held it for review before anything was shown (held); the creator, one of their moderators or a service hid it (hidden: queued chat, TTS and media deliveries were cancelled, the overlay alert retracted, public pages leave it out) or showed it again (restored; a held one is released then). The money is never touched: no refund, the goal and totals keep it. Envelope: subject { type: interaction, id: tint_… }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:tips. Carries no supporter, message, reason text or moderator identity (Tips keeps those in its own moderation log). Never emitted for simulations.

moderation_state.description: The interaction's moderation state after this outcome.

cancelled_effects.description: Deliveries this outcome cancelled before they happened (hidden only; empty otherwise). A consumer that queued the same paid message itself should drop it.
